metadata.title: Antique Singer sewing machine 1935 Thread adjustable guide Replacement

introduction: This antique 1935 Singer machine is missing the adjustable thread guide.

steps.title: Missing thread guide
steps.text: The machine is missing the thread guide as shown here. Otherwise, it is operational.

steps.title: Machining the elements
steps.text:
You will need a lathe to machine appropriately sized elements to replace the mechanism.
I used alumunium for the machined elements. Use high speed to obtain smooth surface as you need the thread to slide correctly.
The assembly may be done used an M5 screw and a cone spring as shown.

conclusion.text: To reassemble your device, follow these instructions in reverse order.
